questions.question: What is the total number of classical languages in India as on 31 October 2024?

options: Anchoring the plant firmly to the soil
Providing structural support above the ground
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Anchoring the plant firmly to the soil) है।

questions.question: Consider the statements regarding India’s first Artificial Intelligence (AI) data bank:  1. Launched by Ministry of Communications2. Aimed at propelling innovation and boosting the country’s national security3. questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (1 and 3 only) है।

questions.question: Which of the following municipalities is NOT a recognised type of municipality under the Constitution of India?
What are the two key elements that form the soul of Indian classical music?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Raaga and Taala) है।

questions.question: Which of the following is a key feature of the Odissi dance form?
options: Use of ‘tribhanga’ posture and sculpturesque poses
Depiction of war scenes through martial movements
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Use of ‘tribhanga’ posture and sculpturesque poses) है।

questions.question: The Gandhi Sagar Dam is a masonry gravity dam located in Madhya Pradesh. On which river is It built?

Which of the following is the primary objective of privatisation in the context of economic policy?
options: To increase government control over industries
To encourage competition and efficiency in the market
To limit the role of the private sector in economic activities

questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (To encourage competition and efficiency in the market) है।
